Archontophoenix cunninghamiana
The Piccabeen Palm (Also known as the Bangalow, King, or Illawarra Palm)
"Ruler of Palms" — That is the literal translation of its genus name, Archontophoenix (from the Ancient Greek archon, meaning chieftain, combined with Phoenix, the date palm). It’s a bold name, but one this Australian powerhouse fully commands.   

The Botanical Brief
Family: Arecaceae (The Palm Family)

Native Range: Eastern Australia (from tropical Mount Elliot in Queensland down to the cooler coastal gullies of Bateman’s Bay in New South Wales).   

Habitat: Rainforest understories, wet sclerophyll forests, riverbanks, and swampy lowlands.
